item.title: [DE|Local] rbb24 Der Tag in Berlin und Brandenburg (Berlin) (Thu 19:17): Berlins Olympia-Absage | Verpackungssteuer in Potsdam | Drohnen am BER
item.description:
Originally published Thu 24 Sep 2026 19:17 IDT.
Berlin hat zwei Tage vor der Abstimmung über den deutschen Olympiabewerber das Handtuch geworfen. Auch bei Sportlern und Politikern in Brandenburg sorgt die Entscheidung für Bedauern. Am BER hat eine Drohne am Mittwoch wieder kurzzeitig den Betrieb lahmgelegt. Und in Potsdam wird über die Einführung der Verpackungssteuer gestritten. "DER TAG in Berlin und Brandenburg" – kompakt und informativ mit dem Neuesten aus Ihrer Region. Abonnieren und hören können Sie den Podcast in ARD Sounds. "DER TAG" gibt es auch im Vorabendprogramm im rbb-Fernsehen, immer montags bis freitags 18 Uhr.

item.title: [EN|In-Depth] BBC Global News Podcast (Fri 07:25): Trump hosts President Xi at state banquet
item.description:
Originally published Fri 25 Sep 2026 07:25 IDT.

Tech billionaires join Donald Trump and Xi Jinping for dinner at the White House at the end of the first full day of the Chinese President's visit to the US. Mr Xi said that in their discussions earlier, he and his host had reached "common understanding on many issues" but didn't elaborate. No concrete breakthroughs have been reported on contentious matters such as Iran and AI. Also: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu fiercely defends military action in the Middle East to a half empty UN General Assembly. Earlier, the Palestinian leader told the same gathering Israel was threatening his people's existence. The Italian government approves a ban on the burqa and niqab in schools. Hundreds of people gather in the Venezuelan capital, Caracas, to call for the return of the exiled opposition figure, Maria Corina Machado. The eviction of an 87-year-old in Spain triggers angry protests and put the country’s housing crisis under the spotlight. And new research on how well dogs can understand the human language.
